title: guardian_ack payload, pv 1 (PROPOSED, docs/VUKA-2-SPEC.md §3 G5)
description: Committed private payload of a guardian_ack event: a guardian's signed response to an alert. Submitted via POST /v1/events (superseding the non-chain POST /v1/alerts/{id}/ack in the contract, PROPOSED 25 Sep), because §3's table classifies guardian_ack as a chain-anchored guardian_event and a bare signed statement cannot become a hash-chained entry outside /v1/events. Numeric fields are integers (spec §5). Adding a field is a pv bump.

incident_id.description: The incident this acknowledgement responds to; must belong to the target subject.

action.description: G5. stand_down closes the incident (§8) and cancels a pending non-duress bank signal (S1, ADR-0037); it can never cancel a duress-triggered one. called_10111 and handling are recorded with no further server effect.
